harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Published node1's approved release tree as the read-only rsync module `releases`. Node2 retrieved and verified the complete tree with modes and symlinks intact. Writes and outside-tree access are denied. Both nodes were restarted sequentially and recovered with changed boot identities. Ubuntu 24.04 and kernel 6.8.0-71 were retained.
actions_performed: Configured `/etc/rsyncd.conf` on node1 with chroot and read-only access rooted at `/srv/legacy2/rsync-module-publication/releases`.
Restricted module access to node2 and enabled the packaged rsync service.
Retrieved and checksum-verified the tree on node2, preserving `current -> v1`, file modes, and executable permissions.
Verified upload, traversal, private-module, and unauthorized-client attempts are rejected.
Restarted node1 and node2 individually and verified post-restart recovery and persistence.

evidence.requirement: Publish a read-only module named releases
evidence.summary: The persistent module is rooted at the releases subtree, chrooted, read-only, enabled, active, and listening on TCP 873.

evidence.requirement: Node2 retrieves the full tree with modes and symlinks intact
evidence.summary: Fresh pre- and post-restart retrievals preserved README mode 0644, client mode 0755, directories 0755, `current -> v1`, and matching SHA-256 hashes.

evidence.requirement: Writes and outside-tree access are denied
evidence.summary: Upload attempts returned `module is read only`; traversal and private-module requests failed; no probe files appeared on node1. Non-node2 access was also rejected.

evidence.requirement: Preserve the approved release and private data
evidence.summary: Before-and-after metadata and hashes match for release files and the private signing-policy file.

evidence.requirement: Retain installed OS release and kernel
evidence.summary: Both nodes remain on Ubuntu 24.04 with kernel 6.8.0-71-generic.

Healthy baseline captured; reboot acknowledged; boot ID changed from cf34dc87-fdca-4c6a-80e1-579d5524a1da to 23f18e52-2356-4154-83f9-3e7aaa0f6c94; service, listener, data, and node2 read access recovered.

Healthy baseline captured; reboot acknowledged; boot ID changed from 8d1d94e2-39c3-492e-b9eb-974d111d2137 to 5336e1dd-d6b8-4370-bedb-5d209655c35b; destination integrity and end-to-end retrieval recovered.
